General.Name: Piramal Enterprises Limited
General.Description: Piramal Enterprises Limited operates as a non-banking financial company in India. The company provides home, home construction, business, personal, secured business, used car, small business loans, and loan against property and mutual funds, as well as real estate developer financing and corporate and mid-market lending products. It also operates distressed asset investing platform that invests in equity and/or debt in sectors. In addition, the company provides life insurance services, as well as engages in fund management businesses. Piramal Enterprises Limited was formerly known as Piramal Healthcare Limited and changed its name to Piramal Enterprises Limited in July 2012. The company was incorporated in 1947 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.
